description: Connect a domain the user already owns (for example app.example.com) to a project. Limited beta: accounts without access get FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED; then keep using the generated URL. Returns the two DNS records to create (a TXT ownership proof and a CNAME, or ALIAS for a root domain, to domains.rightside.cloud). Nothing changes in DNS until they are added. Free tier: 1 custom domain per project and 3 per account; a root domain and its www count as one.

hostname.description: Fully qualified hostname without scheme, path or port, e.g. app.example.com.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying. Generated when omitted.

name: add_domain
